procedure_name: Street Light Repair & New Pole Installation
summary: Mechanism to report non-functional public LED streetlights or request dark-spot illumination poles.
estimated_total_time: 24–48 hours for repair; 15 days for new pole

steps.title: Note pole number and landmark
steps.description: Find the yellow-stenciled pole code or locate exact spot on municipal GIS mobile map.

steps.title: Log ticket on municipal mobile app
steps.description: Submit complaint under 'Street Lighting' category with photo of dark street.

steps.title: Automated dispatch to maintenance van
steps.description: System dispatches ticket to designated ward electrician with SMS alert.

steps.title: Replacement of LED luminaire / cable
steps.description: Electrician repairs damaged underground cable or replaces driver/LED luminaire.

steps.title: Citizen closure feedback
steps.description: Citizen receives resolution SMS and rates service quality.
